results.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM ecommerce.customers c JOIN ecommerce.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ordered_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders_count FROM ecommerce.orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ordered_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

SELECT e.region, AVG(eo.total_amount) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(p.unit_price * oi.quantity) AS total_amount FROM ecommerce.orders o JOIN ecommerce.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN ecommerce.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.region) e GROUP BY e.region;
SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email FROM ecommerce.customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecommerce.orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id)
SELECT p.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM ecommerce.products p JOIN ecommerce.order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY total_quantity DESC;
SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ecommerce.orders o GROUP BY o.status;

SELECT e.customers.customer_id, e.customers.first_name, e.customers.last_name, e.addresses.city, e.addresses.country FROM ecommerce.customers AS e JOIN ecommerce.addresses AS a ON e.customers.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE a.city IS NOT NULL AND a.country IS NOT NULL
SELECT c.name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS num_products FROM ecommerce.categories c JOIN ecommerce.products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY num_products DESC;

SELECT c.name AS category_name, SUM(p.unit_price * oi.quantity) AS revenue FROM ecommerce.products p JOIN ecommerce.order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN ecommerce.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN ecommerce.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;
SELECT e.region, SUM(i.quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity FROM ecommerce.inventory i GROUP BY e.region
SELECT p.product_id FROM ecommerce.products p JOIN ecommerce.inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE i.quantity_on_hand <= (p.unit_price * 3)
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM paid_at) AS month, method, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM ecommerce.payments GROUP BY month, method ORDER BY month, method;
SELECT s.shipment_id, o.ordered_at, s.shipped_at, s.delivered_at FROM ecommerce.orders o JOIN ecommerce.shipments s ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE s.delivered_at > s.shipped_at
SELECT p.product_id, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM ecommerce.products p LEFT JOIN ecommerce.reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id;
SELECT c.code, c.discount_percent FROM ecommerce.coupons c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecommerce.order_coupons oc WHERE oc.coupon_id = c.coupon_id) AND c.ends_at > CURRENT_DATE
SELECT c.code, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM ecommerce.coupons c LEFT JOIN ecommerce.order_coupons oc ON c.coupon_id = oc.coupon_id GROUP BY c.code;

SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS num_returned_orders FROM ecommerce.customers c LEFT JOIN ecommerce.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'returned' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY num_returned_orders DESC;

SELECT e.region, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_orders FROM ecommerce.orders o JOIN ecommerce.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY e.region;
SELECT SUM(e.quantity_on_hand * p.unit_price) AS total_value FROM ecommerce.inventory e JOIN ecommerce.products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id WHERE e.quantity_on_hand > 0
SELECT p.* FROM ecommerce.products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecommerce.order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id = p.product_id)

SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS num_orders FROM ecommerce.customers c JOIN ecommerce.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE EXTRACT(quarter FROM o.ordered_at) = EXTRACT(quarter FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY num_orders DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p.paid_at) AS month, SUM(p.amount - oi.unit_price * oi.quantity) AS refund_amount FROM ecommerce.payments p JOIN ecommerce.order_items oi ON p.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE p.status = 'refunded' GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p.paid_at)

SELECT e.region, COUNT(*) AS num_pending_shipments FROM ecommerce.shipments s JOIN ecommerce.orders o ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE s.delivered_at IS NULL GROUP BY e.region ORDER BY num_pending_shipments DESC;
SELECT p.product_id, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM ecommerce.products p LEFT JOIN ecommerce.reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id HAVING AVG(r.rating) < 3
SELECT h.department_id, COUNT(h.employee_id) AS num_employees FROM human_resources.employees e JOIN human_resources.departments h ON e.department_id = h.department_id GROUP BY h.department_id;
SELECT e.employee_id FROM human_resources.employees e WHERE e.hire_date > '2023-01-01'::date

SELECT h.department_id, AVG(sh.annual_salary) AS current_annual_salary FROM human_resources.salary_history sh JOIN human_resources.employees e ON sh.employee_id = e.employee_id JOIN human_resources.departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id WHERE sh.valid_from <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY h.department_id

SELECT h.department_name, COUNT(h.employee_id) AS employee_count, e.region FROM human_resources.departments d JOIN human_resources.employees e ON d.department_id = e.department_id GROUP BY h.department_name, e.region ORDER BY e.region;

SELECT e1.department_id, e2.first_name || ' ' || e2.last_name AS manager_name, e3.first_name || ' ' || e3.last_name AS reported_to FROM human_resources.employees e1 JOIN human_resources.employees e2 ON e1.manager_id = e2.employee_id JOIN human_resources.employees e3 ON e1.employee_id = e3.employee_id
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM lr.ends_on) AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ecommerce.leave_requests lr WHERE lr.status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM lr.ends_on)

SELECT e1.employee_id FROM human_resources.employees e1 JOIN human_resources.leave_requests lr1 ON e1.employee_id = lr1.employee_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM human_resources.leave_requests lr2 WHERE lr2.employee_id = e1.employee_id AND lr1.starts_on < lr2.ends_on AND lr1.ends_on > lr2.starts_on)
SELECT h.department_id, AVG(h.rating) AS avg_rating FROM human_resources.performance_reviews h GROUP BY h.department_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM h.review_year)
SELECT d.department_id FROM human_resources.departments d LEFT JOIN human_resources.employees e ON d.department_id = e.department_id WHERE e.employee_id IS NULL

SELECT hr.employees.employee_id, hr.employees.first_name, hr.employees.last_name, sh.valid_from, sh.annual_salary, shh.valid_from AS prev_valid_from, shh.annual_salary AS prev_annual_salary FROM human_resources.employees hr JOIN human_resources.salary_history sh ON hr.employee_id = sh.employee_id JOIN human_resources.salary_history shh ON hr.employee_id = shh.employee_id AND sh.valid_from = DATE_TRUNC('month', shh.valid_from) + INTERVAL '1 month' WHERE sh.valid_from > shh.valid_from AND sh.annual_salary > shh.annual_salary

SELECT h.department_id, AVG(DATE_PART('year', NOW() - h.hire_date)) AS avg_tenure FROM human_resources.employees e JOIN human_resources.departments h ON e.department_id = h.department_id GROUP BY h.department_id

SELECT e.employee_id FROM human_resources.employees e JOIN human_resources.performance_reviews pr ON e.employee_id = pr.employee_id WHERE pr.review_year = (SELECT MAX(review_year) FROM human_resources.performance_reviews WHERE employee_id = e.employee_id) AND pr.rating < 3

SELECT d.name AS department_name, COUNT(l.status) AS pending_leave_requests FROM human_resources.departments d LEFT JOIN human_resources.leave_requests l ON d.department_id = l.employee_id WHERE l.status = 'pending' GROUP BY d.name
SELECT h.department_id, MIN(h.annual_salary) AS min_salary, MAX(h.annual_salary) AS max_salary FROM human_resources.salary_history h GROUP BY h.department_id;
SELECT e.employee_id FROM human_resources.employees e LEFT JOIN human_resources.performance_reviews pr ON e.employee_id = pr.employee_id WHERE pr.review_id IS NULL

SELECT h.department_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM h.hire_date) AS hire_year, COUNT(*) AS hires_per_year
FROM human_resources.employees e
JOIN human_resources.departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id
WHERE e.manager_id IS NULL
GROUP BY h.department_id, hire_year
ORDER BY department_id, hire_year;
